Frozen Explorer:
(Under the influence of the Memory Crystal, the last memories of the Frozen Explorer gradually creep into your mind.)
I was sent to these inhospitable lands by the Priests of Light. Almost immediately I met the terrifying monsters that call this place their home.
Soon I learned that these monsters were created by a dark force known as Baluan. Some say that he is a god. I dont't think so, but, judging by his creations, the power he wields is nigh-divine.
(This is the last memory. You can return to Priest of Light Torian.)
